property_summary: The call to c.newEmergencyOracle should succeed exactly when callerCandidate equals this contract (i.e., (callerCandidate == address(this)) == (!reverted)).
change_summary: Change onlyAdmin modifier's require to invert the check (deny admins, allow others), altering which callers can create the newEmergencyOracle and thus observable newEmergencyOracle state.
